title: Code and aggregate results for: Open LLM student role-play shows no detectable advantage over direct difficulty rating and concentrates errors
description: Analysis code, verbatim prompts, registration documents (OSF osf.io/ygvdf), the number-generation script, figure code and aggregate results for a pre-registered study comparing large language model student role-play with the same model's direct rating of item difficulty on sealed held-out responses (EEDI confirmatory; DBE-KT22 and FoundationalASSIST descriptive). No dataset is redistributed; see README for data access.
